chapter.title: Better People, Brighter Tomorrow
chapter.sub: Checklists don't slow a team down.

items.alt: After the service, Ray holds the debrief card — what broke, what almost broke, what to fix before next week. Maya listens.

bubbles.text: Good service. What broke, what almost broke, what do we fix before next week?

items.alt: The empty sanctuary in warm light. Maya stands in the aisle, proud.

bubbles.text: We're not just running gear. We're running a system people trust.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Checklists don't slow a team down — they're what make Sunday repeatable.
